cands.name: Joe Lovvorn

cands.bio: Republican member of the Alabama House of Representatives for District 79 since 2016. Auburn fire department battalion chief, realtor and owner of a Two Men and a Truck franchise. Holds an Auburn University bachelor's degree and MBA. Raised in Graham, Alabama.
cands.gaps: We found no documented stance from Lovvorn on data centers or on growth and development. We found no sponsored bills or actions on homestead taxes, land ownership, immigration, guns, abortion, school choice or police pay in the pages available. His campaign site says tax increases should be a last resort and that he backs teachers and Auburn University funding, but it does not name a specific policy. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026. Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for him this cycle. We found no reported controversies. His birthplace city and the year he began living in Auburn were not stated.

qual.background: He has served in the Alabama House since 2016, after working as an Auburn battalion fire chief, a realtor and real estate broker, and the owner of a Two Men and a Truck franchise. He holds an MBA from Auburn University.
qual.why: Ten years of legislative service plus business ownership and an MBA put him in the high range; his committee chair posts were not counted toward the score.
